data.name: Vibhishana
data.gender_notes: Vibhishana is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Vibhishana is a character from the Hindu epic Ramayana, who was the younger brother of Ravana. He was known for his wisdom, bravery, and loyalty. The name Vibhishana carries the meaning “The Protector” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Vibhishana usually hope their child will grow to embody the protector and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes protection, wisdom, and loyalty towards dharma.
data.etymology: Vibhishana belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “The Protector.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Vibhishana total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

data.cultural_impact: Vibhishana is a significant figure in Hindu mythology, revered for his unwavering loyalty and wisdom. He proved his devotion to Rama, the prince of Ayodhya, by joining him in the war against his brother Ravana. After Rama's victory, Vibhishana was granted the position of the king of Lanka as a reward for his bravery and loyalty.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Vibhishana holds various spiritual significances beyond its cultural implications. It comes from the Sanskrit word "Vibhishana," which roughly translates to "discernment" or "wisdom." Vibhishana's life story is a testament to the power of inner wisdom and understanding, guiding us to make the right decisions in our lives.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Vibhishana, the wise and loyal brother of Ravana, symbolizes redemption and unwavering devotion. His name reveals his transformative journey from being a demon king to becoming an adviser and protector in Rama's kingdom, embodying the power of change and selfless loyalty.

vedic_reference.note: Vibhishana is a character from the Hindu epic Ramayana and is the younger brother of Ravana, the king of Lanka. He is known for his wisdom, loyalty, and devotion to Lord Rama.
